metadata.metric: Unique CVEs documented in Apple security advisories for iOS releases in each calendar month
metadata.source: Apple security releases and linked security advisories
metadata.methodology_note: Counts unique CVE IDs across Apple security advisories whose release title includes iOS. Combined iOS/iPadOS advisories are included because they are Apple's normal iOS security advisory format; standalone iPadOS-only releases are not counted. Multiple iOS branches in one month are deduplicated by CVE ID.
